scope: Focused re-review of all three r1 findings, corrected canonical text and case setups/locators, 35 r2 payloads, original root seal and 28 archived r1 payloads/four snapshots, unchanged source/fixture bytes and 61-requirement/88-case inventory. Original r1 source/fixture analysis remains applicable to byte-identical material. Not a handoff release or compatibility review.

findings_resolution.evidence: REQ-SAMPLER-009 now limits Sample End termination to no enabled loop and explicitly retains sustain/release loops as controlling exceptions. Canonical text and requirements.json agree. The unlooped-end subclause is explicitly outside this finite case selection with a future bounded case required; existing loop cases and counts are preserved.

SIMPLER-022 explicitly enables per-voice Sine 1-Hz LFO with nonzero Volume destination, held source and sustain, then requires discernible note-relative tremolo phase under Retrigger-on before testing Offset with Retrigger-off during continuing tremolo. SAMPLER-025 enables the main Clean low-pass filter at 440 Hz on root-pitch 880-Hz layer-c input, enables its envelope, requires a discernible positive-Amount attack comparison, then repeats at Amount=0. These are explicit exceptions to neutral fixture disabling. Both cases contain mandatory positive_control metadata and record unknown when the active path or observation cannot be resolved; no numerical DSP or phase threshold is invented.

Requirements and cases now have exact evidence_anchors and source/section/HTML-line locators. The five named case groups link their actual sibling support: Simpler007 context-menu Warp/Fade restriction, Simpler023 Classic sample-Gain paragraph, Sampler030 title-menu commands, Impulse009 filter+saturation and Impulse012 per-slot+global controls. Corresponding requirements retain both sections. Relative sample-Gain/filter order is explicitly unknown. All locator lines/sections match the unchanged retained heading map; UI/evidence naming imposes no implementation architecture.

remaining_limitations: All 88 application cases remain unexecuted with exact 12.4.3 applicability U; 46 documentary requirements and 72 documentary case predicates are not target behavior passes.
Round Robin may postdate the target; no target availability, reset/unequal-zone/single-layer behavior is established. Impulse middle six trigger notes remain U.
Positive controls establish eligibility of a future observation; they are not measured target results. Source identity, phase or envelope effects that cannot be distinguished remain unknown.
DSP, timing, MPE/tuning, full routing, random law, persistence, undo, malformed/error/cancel/teardown and unselected subclauses remain required gaps. No device profile or handoff is complete.
